newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank on Thursday called for bids on two-week securities repurchase agreements at an unchanged rate of three percent and said it had left its key interest rates steady.
Bids have to be in at 10 a.m. (0900 GMT) on Friday, the bank said in a statement released after the weekly meeting of its policy-making council.
Last week, the bank allotted 2.03 billion schillings, filling two percent of bids, also at a fixed rate of three percent.

Austria's discount rate has been at 2.5 percent since April, while the Lombard emergency borrowing rate is at 4.75 percent. The Gomex money market rate stands at 3.4 percent. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
